query: Set up a context folder for product-a, a web client for the Acme payments API.
expected_behavior: Loads the context-standard skill before writing any file
Creates product-a/context/ with the five required root files: AGENTS.md, INDEX.md, CHANGELOG.md, decisions.md and open-questions.md
Builds AGENTS.md, INDEX.md and CHANGELOG.md from their templates in the skill's templates/ folder instead of improvising their structure
Creates product-a/context/CLAUDE.md containing only the line @AGENTS.md, because the session runs in Claude Code
Gives every created .md file except CLAUDE.md front matter with all required fields, and sets review_by to verified plus the interval of its volatility (static 12, slow 6, fast 2 months)
Lists every other created file in INDEX.md
Leaves placeholders for project facts it cannot infer, such as non-negotiables and current state, and asks the user for them instead of inventing them
